QuestInfo.name: [Carcion] A Future Without Gods
QuestInfo.0: With #bKeira's#k help, you and your allies defeated Limbo, and even thwarted his attempt to self-destruct. Now's the perfect time to apprehend and question him.
QuestInfo.1: With #bKeira's#k help, you and your allies defeated Limbo, and even thwarted his attempt to self-destruct. Now's the perfect time to apprehend and question him.
QuestInfo.2: The Apostle #rHavoc#k thundered down in a lightning raid, taking both Keira's power and Limbo with him. However, Gaon managed to save Keira herself. You and your comrades have decided to escort Keira to Ereve for the time being. Agreeing to go with you, Keira used the last of her power to cleanse the land, then wished her Anima followers well.
